title: canthium sclerocarpum
intro: Canthium sclerocarpum, commonly known as the West African cherry, is a plant species native to tropical Africa. The health benefits of Canthium sclerocarpum include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and treat various infections due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of the plant include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimalarial effects, making it a valuable resource for treating various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of Canthium sclerocarpum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
